item.title: github: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now includes two new Microsoft AI coding models: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash. The note does not provide technical details beyond their availability.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says the model is intended for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.

  • Source: GitHub
